title: Review the retry helper
prompt: Review src/retry.ts for correctness and unbounded work. Report findings with file and line. Do not change files.

requiredFindings.statement: attempts is used as an inclusive bound, so the operation runs attempts + 1 times
the delay runs after the final failed attempt, delaying the thrown error for no benefit
retryForever has no attempt bound, no backoff, and no cancellation

forbiddenFindings.statement: await inside the loop is required here; reporting it as a defect is a false positive
the generic parameter is sound; reporting it as unsafe is a false positive
